status.description: The campaign status after the action.

execution_id.description: Id of the created execution. Poll it with the [Get Execution API](/api-reference/workflow-executions/get).

campaign_id.description: The implicit `api`-kind campaign that groups single runs of this workflow version.

workflow_version.description: The published version the contact runs through.

revision.description: The new draft revision. Send it as `expected_revision` on the next save.

status.description: The campaign status after the action.

calls.stop.title: Stop a previously initiated voice AI call

agent_id.description: The agent whose dispositions will be evaluated.

transcript.description: The call transcript to run dispositions against.

call_date.description: Optional ISO 8601 date/datetime string for temporal context.

extracted_data.description: Results grouped by category and disposition name. Each leaf contains `subjective` (free-text) and/or `objective` (pre-defined value) fields.

data.description: Grouped disposition results in the same format as post-call execution data.

webhook_url.description: The destination the sample was sent to.

workflow_version.description: The published version whose graph the sample was built from.

sample_path.description: The node ids the sample trail walked, in order.

sample_outcome.description: The outcome of the end node the sample path reached.

url.description: Message displaying the voice URL. This will be `null` if the unlinking is successful.

id.description: The ID of the phone number

disposition_id.description: The ID of the disposition to update.

agent_id.description: If provided, enables scoped (copy-on-write) mode.

category.description: Category name. Resolved against the agent's attached categories; an unmatched name creates a fresh category and moves the disposition into it.

category_id.description: ID of an existing extraction category attached to the agent. Moves the disposition into that category. Preferred over `category`; provide at most one of the two - a payload contain

is_objective.description: Enable or disable pre-defined value selection.

category_id.description: ID of the extraction category the disposition belongs to.

data.description: Standard response for create/update operations on a single disposition.

name.description: New category name. Must be unique among the agent's attached categories.

model.description: New LLM model for the category's extraction pass.

name.description: Category name. Unique among the categories attached to the same agent.

model.description: LLM model used for the category's extraction pass. Applies to every disposition in the category.

agent_id.description: The agent this category is attached to.

created_at.description: ISO timestamp when the category was created.

updated_at.description: ISO timestamp when the category was last updated.

data.description: A named set of dispositions evaluated together in a single LLM pass. The category owns the model used for that pass.

description.description: Updated trunk description for internal reference.

auth_username.description: Updated SIP username (used only when the trunk uses userpass authentication).

auth_password.description: Updated SIP password (used only when the trunk uses userpass authentication).

ip_identifiers.description: Replaces existing IP identifiers when provided.

inbound_enabled.description: Enable or disable inbound calling on this trunk.

outbound_leading_plus_enabled.description: Whether to prepend a leading + to outbound dialed numbers.

is_active.description: Activate or deactivate the trunk. When false, calls will not be placed.

qualify_frequency.description: SIP OPTIONS ping interval in seconds. Use 0 to disable.

media_encryption_optimistic.description: When media_encryption=sdes, fall back to clear RTP if the carrier does not offer crypto in its SDP.

provider.description: SIP provider name (e.g., twilio, plivo, zadarma, telnyx, vonage, custom).

description.description: Optional trunk description for internal reference.

auth_type.description: Authentication method used for this trunk.

auth_username.description: SIP username (present only for userpass trunks).

gateways.description: Ordered list of SIP gateways used for registration and call routing.

ip_identifiers.description: IP ranges associated with this trunk (used only for ip-based authentication).

phone_numbers.description: Phone numbers (DIDs) registered on this trunk.

transport.description: SIP transport used by the trunk.

direct_media.description: Whether RTP is routed directly between endpoints (typically false).

rtp_symmetric.description: Enables symmetric RTP to handle NAT.

force_rport.description: Forces responses to the source port to handle NAT.

media_encryption.description: RTP encryption mode. "no" for plain RTP, "sdes" for SRTP via SDES (TLS trunks only).

media_encryption_optimistic.description: When media_encryption=sdes, whether to fall back to clear RTP if the carrier does not offer crypto.

qualify_frequency.description: SIP OPTIONS ping interval in seconds.

outbound_leading_plus_enabled.description: Whether to prepend a leading + to outbound dialed numbers.

created_at.description: ISO timestamp when the trunk was created.

updated_at.description: ISO timestamp when the trunk was last updated.

data.description: SIP trunk object returned by the API.

min_concurrency.description: Guaranteed concurrency reserved for this sub-account even when the organization is at capacity. 0 means no guarantee.

max_concurrency.description: Hard cap on this sub-account's concurrency. Omit (or send null) for an elastic account that can burst into the organization's unused capacity. 0 pauses the sub-account.

items.description: One contact row for a JSON entries upload. Same shape as the run request - declared fields may be flat or under `custom_fields`.

accepted.description: Rows inserted, including corrections of previously failed rows.

corrected.description: Subset of `accepted` that replaced a `failed_validation` row from an earlier upload.

entries_count.description: The campaign's total entries after this upload.

warnings.description: Accepted rows with a non-blocking issue, e.g. `missing_default_recipient` on a phone-less row when the workflow dials `entry.mobile_number`.
